title: Script table interned-string lookup
summary: Recovered VA 0x4f0b70 as a fastcall table member: mask the string hash using table byte +7, select a 20-byte node from table +16, compare type 4 and string pointer identity, traverse +16 links, and return the node or fixed nil address 0x99a41c. Direct original disassembly and the type-4 tail caller at 0x4f0bc6 establish ECX/EDX arguments. No fields are written.
test_description: GCC freestanding i386 test directly compares original and recovered results across 14336 cases: all 256 count bytes, eight hash values, head/first-chain/last-chain hits, misses, wrong types, distinct string objects with identical hashes, null nonmatching keys, duplicate matching nodes and shift-count wrapping. Independent expected pointers verify first-match and fixed nil results. Byte snapshots verify every table, node, chain and string byte remains untouched after each call. Accepted reference was checked against all 56 immutable original bytes; local linked oracle tests passed.
known_limits: 32-bit original layouts and addresses are retained; a 64-bit port must explicitly adapt layouts and the nil singleton address.
String interning, string content layout beyond the observed hash, allocation and nil object contents are outside the assigned routine.
Valid readable table, string and bucket storage and finite valid chains are caller preconditions. Original behavior on invalid pointers or cyclic chains is not made safe.
No matching machine-code claim is made. Large bucket indices and malformed pointer arithmetic are not exercised; valid tests use eight allocated buckets.
Leaf routine does not use FS, imports, exceptions or external helpers.
